music_prompt: A 50-second instrumental score for a premium Saudi organic date farm TV commercial, maqam Hijaz. Structure: 0-6s intimate and warm, solo oud plucking softly like a family evening at home; at 6s a sudden tape-rewind swoosh and pause; 6-26s a journey back to the farm: ney flute melody over rolling darbuka and frame drum in a gentle maqsum rhythm with oud ostinato, building steadily; 26-34s proud and uplifting swell with warm strings and qanun; 34-44s confident full groove, heartfelt; 44-50s gentle resolution on a final oud strum and soft ney note, clean ending. Cinematic, authentic Arabic instruments, high production value, no vocals.
